snippet.title: Circuit Keep Maze Tower Defense Game Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
Maze tower defense with no fixed paths. Intrusions walk right over your towers, so the maze is whatever you build. They fight back too: phasing through walls, hunting your power grid, swarming to any gap. Pause and rebuild mid-wave. Every tower you've unlocked, every wave. Hold the Core.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4731380/Circuit_Keep/
